details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept that sends a host-metadata beacon when loaded. Its file package/backend-canary.js performs an HTTPS GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle with two query parameters: host, the SHA-256 hex digest of /etc/hostname, and user, the SHA-256 hex digest of the operating-system username. The package ships an inert entry point (index.js exports the string 'controlled') and a marker file containing NPM_BACKEND_DUPLICATE_DOT_MANIFEST_261811825b4c8facd1cfda5079063047, consistent with the package's stated self-description of a "controlled npm backend ingestion duplicate_dot_manifest". No environment variables, tokens, credentials, SSH/AWS configuration, wallet data or other file contents are read or transmitted; only the two digests leave the host.
